command.executable_resolution: Resolve <jmeter-home> only from the future runner manifest after verifying the profile-pinned Apache JMeter 5.6.3 artifact; never resolve the executable through inherited PATH.

locale_evidence.verification: Record the materialized launcher locale and effective JVM Locale.getDefault().toLanguageTag() before comparison; fail evidence promotion if either observation is missing or differs from the requested profile locale.

locale_materialization.portable_contract: Materialize an installed target-OS locale with an explicit UTF-8 codeset; POSIX may use en_US.UTF-8 and Windows may use en-US.
locale_materialization.unavailable_behavior: Fail fixture setup or evidence promotion; do not silently fall back to C/POSIX or an uninstalled locale alias.

charset_evidence.verification: Record System.getProperty("file.encoding") and Charset.defaultCharset().name() from the effective JVM; do not infer either value from the launcher locale or requested command field.

verification.missing_behavior: Fail evidence promotion; requested -D values and environment settings are not observations.

materialization.resolution: The future runner must materialize all three placeholders from an allowlisted runner manifest and launch the exact child without shell interpolation or PATH lookup.
materialization.artifact_digest_gate: profile_digest_verification must pass before launch; case_run_verification remains null until an oracle process actually runs.

process_lifecycle.timeout_behavior: Cancel the owned launcher, wait/reap the exact child, and record a bounded timeout diagnostic; no generic PID/name cleanup is permitted.
process_lifecycle.wait_reap: Wait and reap the exact launcher/Java child on success, error, timeout, and cancellation before evidence is considered complete.

limitations: Apache JMeter 5.6.3 uses ThreadLocalRandom for Random, RandomDate, RandomFromMultipleVars, and RandomString, while __UUID delegates to java.util.UUID.randomUUID(); neither source exposes a supported per-fixture seed setter, so random_seed is null and exact values are asserted only for one-value domains.
__RandomDate in the pinned 5.6.3 source samples an inclusive start and exclusive end epoch-day bound; the one-day fixed case uses 2024-02-29 through 2024-03-01 to make its result deterministic.

__time reads the wall clock. Its millisecond, second, and date outputs are explicitly shape-normalized under NORM-TIME-001; __dateTimeConvert and __timeShift use fixed inputs but their epoch forms require an observed JVM user.timezone=UTC.

The side-effects sampler consumes the preceding capture variables in the same virtual user. Cross-thread interleaving, global-counter order, and plan/configuration expansion results remain unobserved; every side-effect and phase contract is planned and not comparator-enforced.

The plan/configuration probes identify Test Plan, configuration-element, and sampler expansion sites. Preprocessor/postprocessor/listener expansion is not represented in this offline case and requires a separate future fixture; no phase gap is silently treated as covered.
